description: This source file defines the class 'ListsAdminNodeNavigationBuilder', which implements navigation building logic for admin nodes related to content lists in OrchardCore CMS. It manages navigation structure, content item retrieval, and permission handling.

classes.name: ListsAdminNodeNavigationBuilder
classes.description: Implements navigation building for admin nodes related to content lists, handling content type definitions, permission checks, and dynamic menu construction.

methods.name: BuildNavigationAsync
methods.description: Builds the navigation menu asynchronously based on the provided menu item, builder, and child node builders.

methods.name: AddContentItemsAsync
methods.description: Adds content items to the navigation menu asynchronously.

methods.name: GetContentItemsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of content items of a specific type, limited by MaxItemsInNode.

methods.name: AddPrefixToClasses
methods.description: Adds a prefix to CSS classes for icons.
